definitions.acorn: the fruit of the oak, a smooth oval nut in a cup-like base.
definitions.coma: a state of prolonged deep unconsciousness, caused especially by severe injury or illness.
definitions.corn: the chief cereal crop of a district, especially (in England) wheat or (in Scotland) oats.
definitions.corona: the rarefied gaseous envelope of the sun or a star.
definitions.croon: hum, sing, or speak in a soft, low voice.
definitions.macaroon: a light biscuit made with egg white, sugar, and ground almonds or coconut.
definitions.macro: (also macro instruction) a single instruction that expands automatically into a set of instructions to perform a task.
definitions.macron: a written or printed mark (¯) used to indicate a long vowel in some languages, or a stressed vowel in verse.
definitions.manor: a large country house with lands.
definitions.moan: a long, low sound expressing suffering or sexual pleasure.
definitions.moon: (also Moon) the natural satellite of the earth, visible (chiefly at night) by reflected light from the sun.
definitions.moor: a tract of open uncultivated upland, typically covered with heather.
definitions.norm: the usual, typical, or standard thing.
definitions.orca: a large toothed whale with distinctive black-and-white markings and a prominent dorsal fin.
definitions.roam: travel aimlessly over a wide area.
definitions.roan: denoting an animal, especially a horse or cow, having a coat of a main colour thickly interspersed with hairs of another colour, typically bay, chestnut, or black mixed with white.
definitions.room: space viewed in terms of its capacity to accommodate contents or allow action.
